newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Trelleborg jumps on Boliden spin-off talk.
newsitem.headline: Trelleborg jumps on Boliden spin-off talk.

text.p: Swedish mining group Trelleborg jumped seven percent on Thursday morning after a newspaper report that it was to spin off its metal and mining unit Boliden.
At 0915 GMT Trelleborg was seven crowns higher at 104 crowns even though there was some scepticism about the report with management recently saying they wanted to keep the company in one piece.
"Trelleborg has been quite strong lately as the dollar is firmer and with copper prices firmer than expected," one broker said, although adding a cautionary note over management's recent stance.

"But the real drive behind the rise was the Boliden report. Many shareholders have been put off Trelleborg because it is a conglomerate, neither a true mining company nor a true rubber company and this could increase its value."
Business daily Dagens Industri reported on Thursday that Trelleborg was considering spinning off the profit-making Boliden and preparations were underway.
